baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive يُقَالُ, the bare demonstrative هَٰذَا, and the habitual كُنتُم ... تُكَذِّبُونَ form a direct-address reversal.
baseline_models.mechanism: A new utterance points to a now-present referent and answers the audience's repeated act of declaring it false. The sentence therefore does more than rebuke: it replaces their old truth-assignment with a public counter-verdict.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the audible counter-statement that publicly names the now-present referent.
Temporal being supplies the repeated past frame, turning denial from an isolated claim into a settled habit.
Declaring a thing or speaker false supplies the audience's former counter-verdict, which the new utterance reverses.

changed_reading.before: A rebuke reminds the audience that they denied this.
changed_reading.after: A public speech act reverses their long-practiced authority to label the referent false and fixes the present thing under a counter-verdict.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive saying is immediately joined to هَٰذَا, allowing the indicated thing, not only an identified speaker, to carry the evidentiary force.
baseline_models.mechanism: Because saying can be a thing's indication, the realized referent effectively speaks by being present. The passive leaves the voice open while the demonstrative makes actuality itself answer prior denial.

activation_trace.role: A thing's indication supplies a nonhuman evidentiary saying, letting presence itself function as testimony.
The act of declaring something false supplies the proposition that the indicated reality now disproves by appearing.

changed_reading.before: An unseen speaker identifies the punishment in words.
changed_reading.after: The present reality is self-attesting: its very indication says what the audience's denial had refused.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The habitual imperfect تُكَذِّبُونَ under كُنتُم can be tested against the charge-or-campaign branch of ك ذ ب.
baseline_models.mechanism: Denial is read as a sustained charge whose truth depends on whether it carries through. The deictic arrival of 'this' makes that campaign fail its own performance test, so the deniers are not merely contradicted but overtaken by the result they said would not hold.

activation_trace.role: A charge that proves true by being carried through or false by failing supplies the performance test that their denial does not survive.
Temporal occurrence supplies the long duration of the campaign and its collision with a new present.
The uttered announcement supplies the moment at which the failed campaign is openly called.

changed_reading.before: The audience had verbally denied a future fact.
changed_reading.after: Their repeated denial was a campaign that now fails in execution when the denied result arrives and is announced.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening asymmetry of taking a full measure while giving a diminished one is converted into a complete, just, binding, marked account. At the focus, هَٰذَا can therefore present an exhibited settlement: what was discounted in practice and denied in speech has been measured without deficit and entered as an enforceable record.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the formal presentation of the settled account.
Declaring something false supplies the attempted rejection of the liability now displayed.
Measuring one matter against another supplies the transactional comparison that exposes unequal treatment.
Completion without deficiency supplies the standard the final account applies back to those who demanded fullness.
The balance of justice supplies the norm that converts commercial weighing into adjudicative weighing.
Shorting measure and weight supplies the concrete deficit whose reversal requires a full settlement.
A written fixing that imposes judgment or decree supplies the account's binding force.
An inscribed line in a book or register supplies the inspectable itemization presented by 'this.'

structural_cues: The branchless 83:1 cue frames diminishment before 83:2-3 spell out full-taking and loss-giving.
The sequence moves from exchange in 83:2-3 to a binding marked record in 83:7-9 before the deictic presentation in 83:17.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unequal measure, completeness, just balance, imposed writing, and a marked register; I supply the arrow from commercial deficit to a fully itemized eschatological settlement. A live alternative is that the books classify persons rather than record transaction-like entries.

changed_reading.before: 'This' points generally to the punishment or day that was denied.
changed_reading.after: 'This' exhibits a settled account whose full measure answers both practical under-measuring and verbal rejection.

context_deltas.mechanism: What had been held as a deniable future is stirred from stillness, becomes the severe event, brings people to standing, and operates as reckoning and return. The focus is the temporal click at which the alleged non-event is now present; realization itself falsifies the sustained falsification.

activation_trace.role: Temporal occurrence supplies the contrast between what they used to deny and what is now happening.
A charge proved or failed by follow-through supplies the self-defeating performance of their denial.
Stirring the still from repose supplies the transition from presumed non-event to activated reality.
A day's severe happening supplies the event-character of what arrives, beyond an abstract date.
Resurrection and the standing of the Hour supply the bodily realization that tests the denial.
Accounting and recompense supply the operative content of the day they had rejected.

structural_cues: The question of being raised in 83:4 is answered by standing in 83:6, denial in 83:11, encounter in 83:16, and deictic presence in 83:17.
The focus's ثُمَّ marks an ordered consequence rather than a free-standing quotation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies awakening, severe occurrence, standing, and reckoning; I supply the arrow that occurrence is the empirical counter-proof to a failed denial-campaign. The alternative is that denial is primarily moral refusal rather than a forecast exposed by events.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports that a prediction once denied has come true.
changed_reading.after: The event performs its own proof: awakening, standing, and reckoning make the repeated falsification fail in real time.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recited signs are met by a false verbal label, while the surrounding paired books are written, marked, and witnessed with knowledge. The focus's passive saying becomes the hinge where inscription and witness out-speak the dismissive label: هَٰذَا points to evidence that survived being renamed as tales.

activation_trace.role: A thing's indication supplies the record-or-event's capacity to answer through evidentiary presence.
Declaring a report false supplies the rejected label that inscription and witness overturn.
Following recitation supplies the repeated arrival of signs before they are relabeled.
A manifest sign supplies the evidence-bearing object that the audience refuses to read.
False saying or attribution supplies the act of renaming recited signs as something they are not.
Tales classed as false supply the dismissive genre-label opposed to the marked record.
Ordered letters and the written object supply durable evidence that persists beyond oral dismissal.
A line inscribed in a register supplies a resolvable mark that resists relabeling.
Statement grounded in knowledge supplies informed witness to the marked evidence.

structural_cues: The identical marked-book construction appears on both sides of the focus at 83:9 and 83:20.
The oral dismissal in 83:13 precedes the passive counter-saying in 83:17 and the witnessing in 83:21.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitation, manifest signs, false labeling, paired marked books, and informed witness; I supply the arrow that durable inscription and realization out-speak a hostile genre-label. The demonstrative may instead point narrowly to the fire rather than to any record.

changed_reading.before: The verse answers a false claim with a contrary spoken claim.
changed_reading.after: The answer is evidence-bearing: sign, inscription, mark, and witness converge so that what was called a tale now speaks through its persistence and realization.

context_deltas.mechanism: Denial can operate as a deceptive surface: accumulated action becomes an inescapable overlay, a barrier blocks access, and covering hides truth. Against that perceptual regime, يُقَالُ هَٰذَا is forced exposure. The thing denied is no longer mediated by the surface that misrepresented it; it is indicated and recognizable by trace.

activation_trace.role: A thing's own indication supplies the exposure that bypasses the audience's verbal screen.
A patterned cloth whose appearance deceives supplies the focus-root image of denial as a misleading surface, not only a proposition.
An enveloping state with no exit supplies the accumulated perceptual enclosure produced by prior action.
A screening barrier supplies the blocked access that makes direct indication consequential.
Recognition through an effect or mark supplies the post-exposure ability to read reality from visible traces.
Obscuring truth supplies the covering operation that the demonstrative presentation defeats.

structural_cues: The focus's bare demonstrative follows the enclosure and barrier sequence of 83:14-15.
After the focus, states become externally readable in 83:24, sharpening the contrast between occlusion and visible trace.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deceptive appearance, inescapable overlay, screening, recognition by trace, and truth-covering; I supply the arrow that deictic presence strips away a perceptual surface. The cloth image is form-distant, and a live alternative reads the barrier as relational punishment rather than an epistemic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Denial is an incorrect verbal judgment corrected by speech.
changed_reading.after: Denial is also a self-produced surface that hides and miscolors reality; 'this' is the moment the surface can no longer mediate what is seen.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later social sequence reveals the deniers as spectators who laughed, classified believers as lost, and implicitly acted as monitors despite lacking any commission to guard them. The focus's passive verdict becomes a jurisdictional hinge: self-appointed observers lose control of the label, the spectacle reverses, and their own action returns as recompense.

activation_trace.role: A speech-bearing chief whose word has force supplies an analogical image for the effective authority of the passive counter-verdict.
Assigning falsehood supplies the classificatory power the deniers had claimed and now lose.
Joy or astonishment displayed as laughter supplies the first public spectacle of superiority.
Arrogating judgment over another supplies the deniers' unauthorized classification of believers.
Sending and commissioning supply the authority explicitly negated for the would-be judges.
Guarding and oversight supply the supervisory office the deniers were not assigned.
Displayed laughter supplies the reversed spectacle after the authority shift.
Matching one thing with its counterpart until they stand level supplies the reciprocity of the reversed gaze.
A deed's recompense returning to its doer supplies the causal closure of the social reversal.

structural_cues: The branchless 83:30 cue contributes covert peer signaling to the public laughter, labeling, and looking sequence.
The two groups exchange observer and observed positions across 83:29-35, while 83:33 denies the earlier group any commission to supervise.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies laughter, arrogated judgment, negated commission, reversed looking, and returned recompense; I supply the arrow that the passive saying marks a transfer from self-appointed classification to effective judgment. The alternative is a social reversal without a juridical transfer, since the speaker remains unnamed.

changed_reading.before: The verse is a private taunt directed at people who denied punishment.
changed_reading.after: The verse is the hinge in a reversal of jurisdiction and spectatorship: those who judged others are addressed under a verdict they cannot control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated temporal construction links what they used to earn, what they used to deny, and what they used to do. Earning becomes offense, then recompense returns the produced act to its agent. This broadens هَٰذَا: it may indicate not only an external day or fire but the matured return of their own habitual production.

activation_trace.role: Temporal predication supplies the habitual frame that binds denial to the surrounding patterns of earning and doing.
A failed charge supplies denial as an enacted undertaking whose result can return to its agents.
Seeking and acquiring gain supplies the production mechanism by which repeated acts accumulate as one's own yield.
Acquiring or causing an acquisition supplies the bridge from committed conduct to a produced consequence.
Recompense returning to the worker supplies the directional return from deed to doer.
The repeated temporal construction supplies a grammatical echo of the focus and closes the habit-to-result chain.
Bringing an act into existence supplies the concrete output that recompense returns.

structural_cues: The grammar echoes across 83:14, 83:17, and 83:36: what they used to earn, deny, and do.
The final question in 83:36 makes return to the agent explicit after the focus has pointed to 'this.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies habitual earning, acquired offense, enacted work, and recompense returning to its worker; I supply the arrow that the demonstrative can encompass the matured consequence of those acts. The narrower alternative takes 'this' only as the immediately encountered fire or day.

changed_reading.before: The audience encounters an external reality that it had denied.
changed_reading.after: The audience encounters its own habitual denial and conduct returned in matured form; 'this' is consequence as produced possession.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant ق و ل to ق ل ل packet mapping rather than the ordinary speech root. It remains anchored at يُقَالُ and gains a visible scale contrast from the great event: a very small utterance can carry a bodily tremor. The reader supplies that contrastive arrow; downstream prose should present it as sound/root-mapping resonance, never as the lexical gloss of يُقَالُ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The terse passive utterance at word 2 is only a few words long but lands after the denied event has become present.

activation_trace.role: Fewness and smallness supply the minimal verbal size of the verdict, making its brevity functional rather than weak.
A shuddering tremor supplies the embodied aftershock carried by the tiny utterance.
A great calamity supplies the scale contrast that lets a few-word verdict bear disproportionate force.

changed_reading.before: The sentence merely records the words spoken at the encounter.
changed_reading.after: The verdict's very smallness is part of its force: a terse 'this' is enough to trigger the tremor of the great event.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain because the seal belongs to the later drink scene, not the syntax of the focus. It remains anchored through ق و ل as a thing's indication and through the packet's repeated material chain of visible mark, knowledgeable witness, recognition by trace, and impressed seal. The reader supplies the analogy from those marks to authentication; downstream prose should call the focus seal-like, not claim that هَٰذَا literally denotes a seal.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The passive saying plus هَٰذَا functions as a deictic authentication of the thing that had been declared false.

activation_trace.role: A thing's indication supplies the focus anchor for a reality that authenticates itself by being shown.
Visible ornament or engraving supplies the material image of a mark whose presence can be inspected.
A witnessing sign supplies corroboration that turns a mark into evidence rather than decoration.
Recognition from an effect or sign supplies the reading of authenticated reality from its trace.
A stamp and its impression supply the seal-like analogy for the finality of the deictic verdict.

changed_reading.before: The utterance identifies an already obvious punishment.
changed_reading.after: The utterance acts like an authenticating impression: the shown reality bears the mark that makes prior denial no longer sustainable.

strongest_changes: Commercial short-measuring became a fully measured, binding, inspectable settlement presented by هَٰذَا.
Resurrection, standing, and reckoning made the denied event perform the falsification of its own falsifiers.
Recitation, marked books, and witness changed the answer from contrary speech into evidence that outlasts hostile relabeling.
The echoed habitual grammar allowed the demonstrative to indicate a returned product of the audience's own earning and doing.
summary.what_was_special: The three focus roots sustained coexisting speech-act, self-attesting, and failed-performance baselines. Context then activated ledger, inscription, concealment, jurisdiction, spectacle, and returned-consequence mechanisms without collapsing them; the non-dominant ق ل ل mapping and the seal/mark chain preserved the strangest still-anchored readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The antecedent of هَٰذَا may be the immediate fire, the day, the record, the consequence, or a deliberately broad realized complex.
The passive speaker remains unidentified, so jurisdictional transfer is abductive rather than grammatically explicit.
The ق و ل to ق ل ل activation and the seal analogy are packet-grounded resonances, not proposed lexical glosses.
